title: Lucas's Day - February 22, 2022
content: Lucas had a wonderful day! He was very engaged during the storytelling session and even volunteered to act out parts of the story. He also demonstrated great sharing skills, offering his snacks to his peers, for example, Ethan who has ADHD, during break time.

title: Group Activity Reflection - February 22, 2022
content: Today's group activity was challenging for some of our kids. Ethan, who has ADHD, found it difficult to stay focused during the group work. Despite this, the other children, including Lucas, were very supportive and helped him participate by encouraging him and being patient.
